name: Sword of Kas

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book. Artifact random properties use the game's condensed tables (deviations.md).

summary: +3 longsword that crits on 19-20, an extra 2d10 against Undead, and a burning hatred of Vecna.
text: When Vecna grew in power, he appointed an evil and ruthless lieutenant, Kas the Bloody Handed, to act as his bodyguard and right hand. Kas betrayed Vecna with this sword. You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 and deals an extra 2d10 Slashing damage to Undead. While the sword is drawn, you can add 1d10 to your Initiative rolls. You can cast each of the following spells (save DC 18) from it once per dawn: Call Lightning, Divine Word and Finger of Death. The sword is sentient (Intelligence 15, Wisdom 13, Charisma 16) and seeks Vecna's destruction. It has one minor beneficial, one major beneficial, one minor detrimental and one major detrimental property.
